finding: The published helper and Toolkit surfaces do not provide a complete per-topology namespace, state and CLI-metadata isolation configuration. Keep genuine fixed-ID conflict rejection.
observations: EventStore AddHexalithEventStore overloads expose ports, placement/scheduler addresses, component paths and names, but no namespace or Gateway Dapr app-ID override.
DaprSidecarOptions has 32 properties, including AppId and RuntimePath, but no Namespace or CLI metadata-directory property. RuntimePath selects the daprd installation directory.
Calling WithDaprSidecar again creates an additional same-name sidecar resource; it is not an override of the existing composed sidecar.
Host Dapr CLI List scans all daprd processes and command lines. A separate runtime directory does not partition that process inventory.
The Dapr runtime supports NAMESPACE for service/component isolation, but that alone does not isolate actor state or the CLI process inventory.
scope: Read-only inspection of exact published package APIs, local CLI help and primary Dapr source/documentation; no user resource mutations.
